name: Hermetica USDh
oneLiner: Hermetica's synthetic dollar on Stacks now has predominantly tokenized STRC digital-credit backing; docs describe a BTC spot-and-short-perpetual basis strategy
collateral: At the 2026-09-30 14:00 UTC snapshot, Hermetica reported $1,396,969.74 of STRCx in a $1,501,041.77 Ethereum Settlement Wallet, $472,573.22 with Copper, $0.00 with Ceffu, $8,036.50 in the Stacks Redeeming Reserve, and $100,148.12 of Reserve Fund USDC. Total reported backing was $2,081,799.60 against $1,981,448.18 USDh. The STRCx and BTC basis designs remain documented; the report does not itemize all settlement-wallet or Copper assets or establish the mechanism cutover timestamp.
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging: BTC spot long + equal BTC short perpetual futures neutralize directional exposure; mint and redeem via KYC-gated Hermetica app; DIA oracle provides reserve-backed fair value pricing on Stacks

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Stacks transaction 0x6294eebb5e5560d8293268e2c28d3e9533d890007d8a573be80beb8b0db9ad49 deployed the exact tracked usdh-token-v1 contract at block 166,579 on September 19, 2024. Hermetica's official USDh documentation describes the matched BTC spot-long and perpetual-short backing strategy, supporting the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype.
